units.source_text: 她把同一意义随意写成不同的诗。

en.t: She freely turned the same meaning into different poems.

units.source_text: 正在此时，中将派人送信来了。

en.t: Just then, the Captain sent someone with a letter.

units.source_text: 这里的人正在为浮舟之事喧哗议论，不知所措，便把事情告诉了来使。

en.t: The people there were in an uproar over Ukifune, talking anxiously and not knowing what to do, so they told the messenger what had happened.

units.source_text: 来使回去报告了中将，中将大失所望，想道：

en.t: The messenger went back and reported this to the Captain, who was deeply disappointed and thought:

units.source_text: “此人意志如此坚决，所以连无关紧要的回信也不肯写一封，一直疏远我。

en.t: “Her resolve is so firm that she would not even write me a trivial reply, and has kept me at a distance all along.

units.source_text: 现在这样一来，毕竟使我扫兴。

en.t: Now that things have turned out this way, it has spoiled my pleasure after all.

units.source_text: 前天晚上我还同少将商谈，想仔细看一看她那非常美丽的头发。

en.t: Only the night before last I was discussing it with the Lieutenant, hoping to take a careful look at her exceptionally beautiful hair.

units.source_text: 少将曾回答我说‘且候适当机会’呢。”

en.t: The Lieutenant had answered me, ‘Let us wait for a suitable opportunity.’”
He thought it was a great pity.

units.source_text: 便再派使者送一信来，信中说道：“事已如此，夫复何言！

en.t: So he sent another messenger with a letter, in which he wrote, “Since matters have come to this, what more is there to say!
